evidence: The manifest records total_bytes=13033 (0x32E9) and end=0x001434C3 as an exclusive endpoint.
The ROM byte at 0x001434C3 is zero and the next four bytes at 0x001434C4 are RNC\x01.
The payload therefore ends at the byte before the exclusive endpoint, 0x001434C2; the intervening zero is alignment padding.
conclusion: The prior v1 interpretation was superseded: TITLE_BASE_RNC_GRAPHICS_001401DA owns 0x001401DA-0x001434C2, and RNC_ALIGNMENT_PADDING_001434C3 owns the one-byte gap before the next RNC block.
